IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Schual-Berke, Cody, Hudgins and Upthegrove

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a funding source for the airport impact mitigation account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding the airport impact mitigation account;and adding a new section to chapter 82.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A fee is imposed for the privilege of taking off or landing jetaircraft at an airport serving more than twenty scheduled jet aircraftflights per day at an airport operated by a port district in a countywith a population greater than one million. The amount of the excisetax is equal to two dollars for each take off and two dollars for eachlanding. (2) Moneys collected under this section shall be deposited in theairport impact mitigation account created in RCW 43.63A.760. (3) Chapter 82.32 RCW applies to the fee imposed in this section.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, the p. 1 HB 3077remainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
